website (the “Service”, the “Site”) operated by Flight-Experts (“us”, “we”, or “our”). The terms “Flight-Experts”, “Company”, “us”, “we”, or “our” refer to a travel agency specializing in the sales of business class air travel. The term “you” refers to the customer visiting the Website and/or booking a reservation through our travel consultants/agents.

This website is offered to you conditioned upon your acceptance without modification of all the terms, conditions, and notices set forth below (collectively, the “Agreement”). By accessing or using this website in any manner, you agree to be bound by this Agreement. To the extent you book any travel products or services on this website or through our call center agents, you agree that this Agreement shall apply to all such transactions. Please read the Agreement carefully. If you do not accept all of these terms and conditions, please do not use this website or make bookings through this website or our call center agents. Be sure to return to this page periodically to review the most current version of the Agreement. We reserve the right at any time, at our sole discretion, to change or otherwise modify the Agreement without prior notice, and your continued access or use of this website signifies your acceptance of the updated or modified Agreement.
User Representation
By using the website, you imply that:
You are 18 years of age or older,
You possess the legal authority to create a binding legal obligation,
All information provided by you on the website is true, accurate, and complete,
Your use of this website is limited to making or managing travel reservations for yourself or on behalf of someone else.

Flight-Experts reserves the right to request documentation for any reservation that requires further validation from the cardholder. Cancellation may occur if the requested documents are not provided.
Booking Process
For your convenience, the following terms in these Terms of Use shall have the meanings below:
“Service Element” – a single product or service listed on the Site that can be booked independently (e.g., flight).
“Travel Supplier” – a vendor of one or more Service Elements (e.g., airlines). Flight-Experts does not act as principal but makes arrangements with third-party Travel Suppliers for Service Elements.

“Booking” – a negotiation process with the Travel Supplier carried out by you while using this Site for the purpose of obtaining one or more Service Elements that may result in a contract with the Travel Supplier once we receive full payment.
To complete a Booking, the following steps ensure its validity:
When we place Service Elements on our Site, we are inviting you to confirm their purchase. This is done only once you press “Book” on the payment page of the Site.

Once you have done so, you have given your approval (which cannot be withdrawn if you change your mind) to Flight-Experts to purchase the relevant Service Element(s) from the relevant Travel Supplier(s) (e.g., your “Booking”). We are free to accept your approval on behalf of the relevant Travel Supplier or to reject it, at our sole discretion.

We will then need to check the availability of the relevant Service Element(s). The Flight-Experts email confirmation that you receive after pressing “Book” is NOT the contractual acceptance of the Booking but merely an acknowledgment that we have received your confirmation to proceed with the purchase of chosen tickets.
If the relevant Service Element is available, your Booking will be processed. The contract pertaining to the relevant Booking is formed when payment in full has been received.
The contract between you and the relevant Travel Supplier will relate only to those Service Elements confirmed by email with booking reference numbers and ticket numbers for your air travel.

The terms of your Booking (such as price, availability, and/or dates of travel) are not guaranteed until the contract is formed between you and the Travel Supplier and a ticket has been issued and/or a reservation has been made and confirmed by the Travel Supplier. Once you have completed the Booking stage, you can only cancel or change the details (such as names or destinations) of your Booking at our sole discretion and in accordance with these Terms of Use.

These Booking processes will apply to any of our individual Service Element’s Terms of Use set out below. We reserve the right to change the Booking process at any time, with changes automatically taking effect from the date such changes are posted on this Site.
Airline Rules, Itinerary Changes, and Price Changes

Airline tickets are subject to the published conditions of carriage and rules of the applicable airline. Airlines might also assess their own taxes and fees on your flights, but if such additional costs arise, you will be informed in a timely manner. Please contact us for additional information if you have questions.

The contract of carriage in use by the applicable airline, when issued, shall be between the applicable airline and the passenger. Airlines retain the right to adjust flight times and schedules at any time – schedule changes can result in an itinerary that falls outside of contractual agreements. Airlines may also change or cancel flights or itineraries at their discretion.

In the event of a flight cancellation while at the airport, please see the airline ticketing counter or gate representative, as they have the most power to change your itinerary to the next available flight or accommodate you per the airline rules. This is the fastest way to get you on the next flight out.

Travel insurance is highly recommended but not directly offered by Flight-Experts. Instead, we have partnered with an insurance broker (see here) who can provide competitive offers based on your requests. The insurance covers a variety of issues, from illness to problems with travel service providers, ensuring you get what you paid for or can make alternative arrangements.
Purchases

The Global Distribution System (GDS) shows real-time availability for flights up to eleven months from today’s date. Flight-Experts cannot provide service for any request beyond the specified time frame. Please note that all fares must be paid in full once the tickets are issued and sent to your email.

If you wish to purchase any product or service made available through the Service (website), you may be asked to supply certain information relevant to your purchase, including, without limitation, your personal data for issuing tickets, your credit card number, the expiration date of your credit card, billing address, and more.

You represent and warrant that: (i) you have the legal right to use any credit card(s) or alternative payment method(s) in connection with any purchase; and that (ii) the information you supply to us is true, correct, and complete.

We use third-party service providers for the purpose of facilitating payment and completing the purchase. By submitting your information, you grant us the right to provide the information to these third parties subject to our Privacy Policy.

We reserve the right to refuse or cancel your order at any time for reasons including, but not limited to, product or service availability, errors in the description or price of the product or service, error in your order, or other reasons. We also reserve the right to refuse or cancel your order if fraud or an unauthorized or illegal transaction is suspected.
Exchanges, Cancellations, and Refunds

Flight-Experts offers tickets at discounted fares obtained from third-party companies, which contain more restrictions than tickets available to the general public and booked directly from the airline. This means that many fares are non-reroutable, non-exchangeable, and non-transferable. Name changes on tickets are also not allowed – only the original passenger can use the ticket(s). By purchasing the ticket from Flight-Experts and confirming the checkout form, you agree that these terms are reasonable and necessary to maintain the operations of the Flight-Experts business.

If you need to cancel your ticket for any reason, please contact your Travel Consultant to review your options. Cancellation and refund terms and conditions will apply to your reservation and purchase of travel-related goods and services that you select from airline suppliers. If refunds are possible for the particular ticket, they will not be in cash but company credit will be offered instead. In addition, a $250.00 fee per person will be charged to process such cases.

No-show tickets cannot be refunded, nor can they be exchanged. Unless the reservation is canceled up to 72 hours before departure and the trip rescheduled before the original departure date, the ticket is suspended and refunds are not possible.

Based on U.S. Department regulations, you can request a free refund or exchange the current reservation for a new one free of charge within 24 hours after the initial booking. This rule only applies to bookings made in the United States. If you are booking a flight that does not originate from the US or vice-versa, please contact your Travel Consultant to find out whether the 24-hour free cancellation rule applies.
Missed Flights

If you miss your flight, go to the airline counter immediately or call your Travel Consultant if you are not near the airport. Missed flights are not refundable, and changes or replacement flights will be at the discretion of the airline supplier. In some cases, we may be able to help you, but in most cases, you will not be provided with a replacement flight unless the airline itself allows it.
Baggage Allowance

Travelers may have to pay additional fees at the airport if their checked items exceed the weight, size, or number specified in the standard baggage allowance of the airline. Some airlines do not offer any free baggage allowance. Baggage allowance for your specific trip will be explained to you to ensure you are fully aware of all baggage terms (weight, size, pieces of baggage) before confirming the booking. Baggage allowance policies and baggage fees associated with checked or carry-on baggage vary widely and are subject to change by the airlines at any time.
Frequent Traveler Points

Frequent traveler awards (miles, points, etc.), upgrades, certificate vouchers, and other discounts or incentives may not apply to some Flight-Experts flights. Please check with the airline directly regarding its frequent flyer program rules and guidelines. Some fares may not qualify for airline mileage accrual. Please contact your Flight-Experts Travel Consultant for more details on mileage accrual.
Ticket Protection: Terms and Conditions

Ticket Protection is a service provided by Flight-Experts to assist you in dealing with unexpected circumstances and obtaining refunds from airlines where applicable. This is not an insurance policy. The following outlines the scope of the service and the conditions under which it applies.
Lost Baggage

Ticket Protection covers baggage mishandled by airlines or airport employees. If your checked baggage is not returned to you within 120 hours of your flight arrival time, Flight-Experts will compensate you $1000 per undelivered bag. Compensation is limited to two missing bags per person and applies only to baggage checked in at the airport. Carry-on bags are not covered. You must file a claim with the airline before reporting your mishandled bag to Flight-Experts. Report mishandled bags to Flight-Experts within 24 hours of your flight’s arrival time by calling or emailing your Flight-Experts consultant. Service cannot be provided for bags reported missing after the 24-hour deadline.
Missed Connection, Delayed, or Canceled Flights

If you miss a departure or connecting flight, or if there is a delay or cancellation that affects your journey, Flight-Experts will work with the airlines on your behalf to obtain a free exchange (subject to seat availability in the same booking class) or retain travel credit for future use. Flight-Experts will process these cases without any agency service fees, though airline fees or fare differences may apply. Processing fees are waived only for the first change of the reservation.
Illness

If you are unable to travel due to illness or hospitalization, Flight-Experts will work with the airline to obtain a full travel credit or refund (subject to airline fare rules) for all unused and partially used tickets, provided you cannot continue the trip. To be eligible for airline credit or refund, you must provide hospital admittance or discharge forms, or a doctor’s note to Flight-Experts and cancel your ticket reservation before the scheduled departure.
By using Ticket Protection, you agree to the terms and conditions set forth above. For any questions or further assistance, please contact your Flight-Experts consultant.
Supplier Rules and Restrictions

Additional terms and conditions will apply to your reservation and purchase of travel-related goods and services selected from the airline. Please read these additional terms and conditions carefully on the airline websites. You agree to comply with the terms and conditions of purchase imposed by any supplier with whom you choose to deal, including, but not limited to, timely payment of all amounts due and adherence to the suppliers’ rules and restrictions regarding availability and use of fares, products, or services. Flight-Experts reserves the right to cancel your booking if full payment is not received in a timely manner.

Some airlines may require you to present a credit card or cash deposit upon check-in to cover additional expenses incurred during your travel. This deposit is unrelated to any payment received by Flight-Experts for your booking. You acknowledge that some third-party providers offering certain services and/or activities may require you to sign their liability waiver before participating in the service and/or activity they offer.

You understand that any violation of such suppliers’ rules and restrictions may result in the cancellation of your reservation(s), denial of access to the applicable travel product or services, forfeiture of any monies paid for such reservation(s), and/or debiting your account for any costs incurred by Flight-Experts as a result of such violation.
Travel Destinations and Visa Requirements

International travel necessitates passengers to possess a valid Passport or another internationally recognized identification document, which must be presented for all international flights. Some countries may additionally require a visa and/or health card. It is the responsibility of passengers to ensure they have all necessary travel documents at check-in. While our Travel Consultants will provide assistance to the best of their abilities, passengers are strongly advised to review visa requirements for all layovers, as certain countries may mandate a transit visa. Passengers transiting via or connecting between airports within the European Union – Schengen Zone may require a Schengen Entry visa. For updated requirements, please contact the embassy of the country you plan to visit or transit through.
Certain countries may have specific criteria for one-way travel – passengers must verify their eligibility for one-way travel to avoid any issues.

Although most travel, including international travel, is typically trouble-free, travel to certain destinations may involve greater risks. Flight-Experts advises passengers to review travel prohibitions, warnings, announcements, and advisories before finalizing travel plans to international destinations. Information about conditions in various countries and the associated travel risks can be found on reliable online sources, such as the official websites of state agencies in the countries you intend to visit.

Flight-Experts does not guarantee that travel to any particular international destination is advisable or without risk when offering to sell travel to those destinations upon your request. Flight-Experts is not liable for any damages or losses that may arise from travel to such destinations.

Transaction and Currency Conversion Fees

All transactions are in US Dollars. We may issue a quotation in your local currency for customer convenience, but all invoices and payments will be requested in US Dollars. Any foreign currency quotations will be converted to US Dollars using the conversion rate listed on ‘Yahoo Finance’ on the date of the order. We do not add any transaction fees or commissions for this conversion. However, Flight-Experts cannot be responsible for any currency conversion fees applied by the customer’s financial institution.

Currency exchange rates and foreign transaction fees applied by the customer’s financial institution are determined solely by the customer’s financial institution on the day they process the transaction. If you have any questions about these fees or the exchange rate applied to your booking, please contact your financial institution directly.
Refunds and Chargebacks

In any circumstance, after confirmation and payment, refunds and chargebacks will be discussed and handled based on the terms and conditions of the travel suppliers and the circumstances of the request. If we detect any fraud, chargebacks, or disputes, we reserve the right to block the user’s account and report the user to the respective credit card or bank institution.
SMS Terms and Conditions
Data Security measures?

We implement robust data security measures to ensure the protection of your personal information. Access to sensitive data is restricted to authorized personnel only, using role-based permissions and multi-factor authentication for enhanced security. All data is encrypted during transmission and storage to prevent unauthorized access. Physical documents are secured in locked storage, while digital data is stored on encrypted servers protected by firewalls and intrusion detection systems.

Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments are conducted to identify and address potential risks. Data backups are performed routinely and stored securely to enable recovery in case of data loss. Employees receive training on data protection policies, safe handling of sensitive information, and recognizing cybersecurity threats. Additionally, we maintain a clear incident response plan to swiftly address any data breaches, ensuring containment, notification, and remediation. These measures uphold the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of your information.
